operations.title: Defect annihilation defines a maximal cocycle-level readout space
operations.statement: A^n(S)=Z^n(H) intersect ker(Omega_(n+1)^*) is the unique maximal target-cocycle subspace pulled by S to source cocycles. Without Omega=0 it need not descend to target cohomology classes.

operations.title: An exact target cocycle can acquire a nonzero source class
operations.procedure: Use target Z^2 --[1 0]--> Z, exact cocycle ell=[1 0], source Z->0, and S(1)=(1,1).
operations.outcome: ell represents zero target cohomology but S^*ell=1 is a nonzero source class.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies treating the maximal admissible cocycle space as a cohomological pullback without stronger chain compatibility.
